sentences.text:
The petitioner is aggrieved by the order dated 10.02.2017 passed by the learned S.D.J.M.,
Paralakhemundi in G.R. Case No.174 of 2015, which is now pending in the Court of the learned CJM-cum-Assistant Sessions Judge, Paralakhimundi, whereby cognizance of the offences punishable under Sections 420/468/471/409/120(B)/34 of I.P.C. has been taken against him.
After cognizance order was passed by the learned Court below, charges have been framed against the petitioner and the trial is proceeding.

At this stage, the petitioner has approached this Court seeking quashing of the cognizance order on the ground that on the selfsame ground, he was subjected to prosecution by another complainant in G.R. Case No.335 of 2013.
The learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gajapati, Paralakhemundi vide its judgment dated 05.04.2019 has acquitted the petitioner in that case.

3. Relying upon the said judgment, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that on the selfsame ground, the present complainant is prosecuting him in the instant case, which needs to be quashed instead of subject him to trial.
4. Since the trial in the instant case is at an advance stage and the impugned order was passed on 10.02.2017, I am not inclined to entertain this petition at this belated stage.
However, liberty is granted to the petitioner to raise all the points which has been raised in this present petition before the learned trial Court at the appropriate stage.
If such issues are raised before the learned trial Court, the same shall be considered on its own merit.
5. With this observation, the CRLMC is disposed of.
